notes:
Add a model, the easy way: one search box over a catalog of good models, each showing its download size, whether it fits this computer, and what it is good at.
Paste anything into it: a model name, a Hugging Face link, an API key or a server address. Brain works out what it is and offers the right button.
Every model you add gets a one-line test first, with a plain-English result. It joins the room right away.
Hugging Face GGUF models download straight through Ollama, with a progress bar.
LM Studio, vLLM and other OpenAI-compatible servers are found from a pasted address, with or without /v1, and list their models automatically.
Models you install outside the app now show up by themselves, with Add and Add all buttons.
Change any participant's model from the room. Brain warns you when the seated models won't fit in memory together.
Online services now pick a current model from your account's own list (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Hugging Face), and retired models are swapped out automatically.
Fixed: newer OpenAI, Claude and Gemini models refused messages with an error about temperature. Fixed: OpenAI project keys (sk-proj-) were rejected.
